description: Six-turn voice conversation over five minutes, including continuous spoken output, a child delegation, and a follow-up after completion.

rounds.name: Greeting
rounds.text: Good morning. Please greet me and tell me briefly how you can help.

rounds.name: Continuous spoken output
rounds.text: Please answer aloud in one continuous response. Count from one to twenty at a steady pace. Finish by saying the sequence ends at twenty.

rounds.name: Spoken follow-up
rounds.text: Give me one short practical tip for remembering that count, and say it aloud.

rounds.name: Delegated read-only tool request
rounds.text: Please delegate this read-only lookup to the helper agent. Ask it to read voice-e2e-sentinel.txt from the workspace, then tell me the exact marker it finds.

rounds.name: Follow-up after delegation completes
rounds.text: Now that the helper has completed its lookup, repeat the exact marker and tell me that the file read succeeded.

rounds.name: Closing turn
rounds.text: Please close with a short spoken summary of what the helper verified.
